notes.title: Bundle Release: Get All Our Studio's Roguelikes at Once!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that you can now purchase (or complete your collection of) all three of our roguelikes at a significant discount. This bundle might interest those who want to track the progress of our tiny studio over the years. If you particularly enjoy any of the games, please don't hesitate to leave a review on its page. This helps us tremendously and shows us that people want more games like it.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43539/Think_and_Watch/

Meanwhile, we are working on something very secret, so shhh... Stay tuned!

notes.title: Full Release is here!
notes.notes:
Greetings Predictors!

Today with a big balance patch that polishes different numbers in the game for more interesting choices, "Predictors" is out of Early Access. Thank you all who help to make it better during these months!

Saying that doesn't mean that the game's development is stopped. While serious updates depend heavily on demand, we are determined to watch game balance and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2149330/view/5254045511855102700]still want to improve additional languages to support them[/url] - don't hesitate to get in touch with us if you want that too and can help with your language :)

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: The new translations (Update)
notes.notes:
Hi Predictors! 

Now the game officially supports three languages.

You can also switch the game to one of the other languages whose translations still need improvement:

[list]
[*] Spanish
[*] German
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese
[*] Turkish
[/list]

Please let us know if you can help fix additional languages.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Big Multiplayer Update: invite up to 3 friends, share loot, and more.
notes.notes:
Hi predictors!

- The last update allows you to play together with up to 3 steam friends (so four players max);
- Important UI improvement for multiplayer: now every player sees the first step from every ally;
- Enemies are scaling now: they have more health for every player.
- Now you have common loot - it means every player gets the same artifacts and resources (except health and mana potions).

We are watching closely and going to improve balance or fix bugs if we find something new.

[previewyoutube=vcHipNOhzog;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy!
